subject: Post-call compliance alignment — SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@finvox.com>, FinVox Security <security@finvox.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call compliance alignment — SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA next steps

Hi Oliver / FinVox security team —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the procurement path: I’ve summarized the key pain points, our proposed mitigations, and the specific artifacts you requested during the call.

Pain points you called out:
- SOC 2 attestation: need Type 2 or an acceptable bridge plan for go-live
- Audit log access and retention (7+ years for certain transaction types)
- Data processing terms: DPA redlines around retention, subprocessors, and breach notifications
- Evidence for recent pen test & vulnerability management cycle

What Redwood can provide (deliverables & timing):
- SOC 2 Type 2 report (most recent) — PDF summary attached, full report under NDA (we can provision a secure link) — target: within 5 business days
- Sample audit-log export (anonymized) showing event types, retention metadata — attached CSV sample
- DPA draft with suggested redlines (attached docx). We will mark each clause with options (keep / negotiate) — target: draft with comments by Fri 11/20
- Pen test summary + remediation timeline (we maintain a CVE remediation tracker; can share an executive summary) — target: 48–72 hours for summary

Questions / clarifications we need from you to prioritize:
1) Which business units and transaction classes require >7yr retention? (this determines storage tiering and export paths)
2) Will FinVox require direct access to raw audit logs or will periodic certified exports be sufficient?
3) Preferred method for exchanging full reports: SFTP, secure SharePoint, or DocuSign/HelloSign for NDAs?

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the list of artifacts you need and the intended recipients for the evidence set (security@finvox.com + one procurement lead) — by EOD Thu 11/19
- Redwood to share SOC2 summary & audit-log sample (attached) and a DPA redlines draft by Fri 11/20
- Quick technical Q&A with our infra lead (Rishi) to validate log schema & retention policy — 30 min session; suggest Mon 11/23 or Tue 11/24

Attachments (quick index):
- SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (summary of scope & period)
- audit-log-sample.csv (anonymized, includes timestamp, event_type, user_id_hash, resource, action, retention_flag)
- DPA-redlines-v1.docx (commented draft)

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation on recipients and the retention classes. Happy to tighten timelines if you have a target procurement window.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0137

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference platform
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@finvox.com>

Cc: FinVox Security <security@finvox.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:02:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call compliance alignment — SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA next steps

Thanks, Irene — good summary. Quick answers below and a couple of constraints from our side.

Answers:
- Retention: our payments compliance team requires 7 years for settlement/chargeback traces, but we only need detailed logs for the first 90 days for operational debugging; after that, an indexed/archived export is acceptable as long as it contains the same event taxonomy.
- Access method: certified periodic exports are fine for now (monthly), but procurement will want the ability to request on-demand exports up to 6 times per year.
- Full reports: we prefer SFTP for large artifacts (SOC2 full report under NDA), and DocuSign for contractual signoffs.

Constraints:
- Final procurement window is tight — we need vendor selection by Dec 10 to hit our Q1 roadmap.
- Our legal team will want an initial pass at DPA redlines; please highlight the clauses you expect to be most contested (we will push on retention and subprocessors).

Action items for Redwood: please share the SOC2 summary + audit-log sample and tag the DPA clauses you expect friction on. Also, can Rishi confirm the exact schema fields in the audit export? That will help our compliance team validate the monthly certified export.

I’ll coordinate internally and confirm who on procurement should be copied (likely procurement@finvox.com). Thanks again.

—
Oliver Grant
Head of Security & Compliance | FinVox
oliver@finvox.com | +1 646 555 0189
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@finvox.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call compliance alignment — SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA next steps

Hi Oliver — looping in with technical detail on the audit log schema and retention options.

Schema (fields included in the attached audit-log-sample.csv):
- event_timestamp (ISO8601)
- event_id (uuid)
- user_id_hash (sha256)
- client_ip (redacted)
- service (string) — e.g., inference, embeddings, auth
- resource (string) — resource id/type
- action (string) — e.g., token_generate, model_load, token_cache_hit
- request_payload_hash (sha256) — for tamper evidence
- retention_flag (enum) — immediate, 90-day, 7-year
- signed_digest (base64) — optional, ledger-style digest for certified exports

Retention options we support:
1) Hot storage: 90 days (full fidelity), low-latency exports
2) Cold archived export: 7 years, compressed & indexed (monthly certified export possible)
3) Customer-managed S3/GCS bucket push for long-term retention (we can push monthly exports)

We can produce certified exports that include a signed digest (signed by Redwood key) to attest completeness of the export; let us know if you need timestamped notarization.

On the DPA comments — Irene / Laura will mark the clauses we expect negotiation on. From a platform perspective, subprocessors list is the typical ask; we keep an enumerated list of cloud infra providers and monitoring vendors that we share under NDA.

If useful, I can join the technical Q&A next week to walk your team through the sample CSV and retention flows. Suggested windows: Mon 11/23 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 11/24 09:00–10:00 PT (30 min).

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Procurement contacts: procurement@finvox.com (cc will be included on the next note). We’ll ask legal to send initial DPA redlines by Fri 11/20.

Confirming the technical Q&A: Mon 11/23 10:00–10:30 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite with a dial-in and an agenda (schema review, retention flows, export procedure).

I will also coordinate how we will deliver the NDA for the full SOC2 report — SFTP is preferred, and security@finvox.com will monitor the transfer.

Oliver
